title: Ya Hamsheere Raza
body:
Ya hamsheere raza 2
Assalamo alayka ya kareema
Ya Kareema
Tera bhai imame zamin hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tera baba dare hawaij hai
ya kareema - 6
tune paaya hai zainabi rutba
kazmi hai hasab nasab tera
<<DIVIDER>>
hai raza ki riza teri marzi
hai gilaafe haram tera parda
sar pe ahle kisa ka hai saya
aapne nam fatema paya
<<DIVIDER>>
aap zeenat hai apne baba ki aur rakhti hai zainabi lehja
Fatema zehra
tere rauze ko ye sa'adat hai
markaze fatema se nisbat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fark do markado me itna hai
wo baqaiyya ye qum ki jannat hai
shahzadi jo tere rauze par
motariz horahe hai sajde par
<<DIVIDER>>
ehteraaman hai shukr ka sajda aur wo bhi khuda ke kehne par
saath dono jahan aate hai
jabhhi wo jamkaran aate hai
tujhse milne ko tere rauze par
<<DIVIDER>>
khud imame zamaan aate hai
pohchi jo qum ajeeb manzar tha
kale parcham lage the har ek jaa
aise matam kiya hai bhai ka
<<DIVIDER>>
qum ko tune banaya karbobala
ilmo idraak aagahi dede
misle behlol zindagi dede
naqshbardaare za'ereen bana
<<DIVIDER>>
apne rauze pe naukri dede
hai ye rehan ki dua bibi
fikre darwesh par nazar ho teri
haath bechain hai ye matam ko
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre zehra pe ho azadari
